name: Tom mu ni chay toi
summary: Tôm mũ ni, the slipper lobster, cooked with garlic at the night market.
howToEat: Order it with garlic. The market opens at 17:00.
where: Võ Thị Sáu and Phạm Văn Đồng, in the open yard in front of the daily market.
seoTitle: Tom mu ni chay toi — garlic slipper lobster in Con Dao
seoDescription: Tôm mũ ni cháy tỏi is slipper lobster cooked with garlic at the Côn Đảo night market.
